name: vizpane
description: Rendered Mermaid diagrams for Claude Code and Codex answers, in a cmux pane next to the agent.

interface.shortDescription: Mermaid diagrams from answers, rendered in a cmux pane
interface.longDescription: When a turn ends and the answer contains a Mermaid code block, vizpane shows the answer rendered in a cmux browser pane. No server, no daemon, local files only.
